title: bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2: hard-capped STNFS discrete log in GT

claims.statement: For each production instance with nonidentity P in G1 and z in GT (including z=1), compute g=e(P,Q0)=pairing(Q0,P,final_exponentiate=True), solve a=log_g z with the published Special-Tower Number Field Sieve in F_{p^12} using the Guillevic-Singh BLS12-381 polynomial and Table 10 parameters, return Q=[a]Q0, and verify e(P,Q)=z. The algorithm is HARD-TRUNCATED: it counts its own instruction equivalents and returns FAILURE when the cumulative work reaches R_cap=2^135.146602479037 scalar instructions, so the submitted bound is an enforced cap, not an expected value. R_cap = 2 * 2 * 128 * 2^126.146602479037, where 2^126.146602479037 is the GS21 STNFS model total recomputed from the published Table 10 parameters (their table rounds it to 2^126), 128 = 16 cycle-equivalents per model operation times 8 scalar instructions per cycle (16 is 1.41x the worst measured measured/model ratio published for this model family, BD19 Table 6 log2(c_sieve)<=3.5, and 8 is the widest current AArch64 scalar retirement width), the first factor 2 charges retries pessimistically (one capped attempt assumed to succeed with probability only 1/2), and the second factor 2 is the Markov truncation P[T>2E[T]]<=1/2. The 1.41x surplus inside the 16 arises because the omitted phases are 28+ bits below the core (BP14 descent at L[1/3,1.44] vs L[1/3,1.923] is ~2^-28 of the sieving term at p^12=2^4572; ECM cofactorization is ~2^87.6, 38 bits below). With H=2^14 reference operations charged explicitly for the final pairing checks and the G2 scalar multiplication, and C=20,000 instructions per target operation, the cap is W_cap=2^120.858890099488 target-group-operation equivalents. Success probability is at least 1/2 over uniform nonidentity P, uniform z and fresh coins, by Markov's inequality applied to the algorithm's total work, which exceeds the required 0.39. Peak storage is at most 2^72.389801 bytes; preprocessing is the field-only relation collection and linear algebra, charged in full per instance with no reuse credit and reported as the same upper bound 2^120.858891; nonuniform advice is 0. No auxiliary powers are used. The score is log2(W_cap)=120.858891. This is an analytic reproduction of a published cost model at production parameters, not a production-size execution.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the GS21 BLS-381 STNFS relation-collection, linear-algebra and total cost from the published Table 10 parameters, then recompute this submission's instruction conversion (16 cycle-equivalents per model operation at 8 instructions per cycle), its charged retry factor 2, its Markov truncation factor 2, the explicit H=2^14 verification charge and the normalized hard-capped score. The script asserts that the recomputed sieving space matches the published 2^124.08, that the total is within 0.25 bits of the published 2^126, that the calibration factors dominate the worst measured published ratio and widest AArch64 retirement width, that the cap is exactly twice E[T], and that the normalized score matches the claim to 1e-6. It is arithmetic evidence for the ledger, not an attack run.
